decisions.diagnosis: On about 40 scattered days the feed published every one of the 4 channel records twice (one channel on 2024-02-26 for direction 337), doubling those days' totals; dropping the exact repeats restores them.
decisions.evidence: duplicates(): every extra record exactly repeats another (matched_slots = slots), 8 records per slot instead of 4, e.g. 2024-03-24/25 +726 bikes per direction; doubled() level 1.4-2.5 on the same days; neighbour sites 254 and 554 show the same doubling on 2022-09-08 and 2022-09-10.

decisions.diagnosis: Both directions report zero through the whole day on the counter's first day of data (installation or commissioning), so the riders who passed were not counted and cannot be recovered.
decisions.evidence: zeros(counter=True): 10.75 h, 8.25 daytime h, usual 248 bikes; day totals 109/147 vs 277/242 the next day.

decisions.diagnosis: The counter stopped detecting mid-afternoon and reported 'good' zeros for a week in both directions while neighbours counted normally; the lost counts cannot be recovered.
decisions.evidence: zeros(counter=True): 159.75 h, usual 3160 bikes; site 254 had 230-555 per direction per day in the same days; counts stop abruptly after slot 54 on 2018-06-01.

decisions.diagnosis: Six weeks of all-zero 'good' records in both directions while nearby site 254 counted normally (sibling City of Sydney Ecocounter 554 had a similar outage); the counts were never delivered and cannot be recovered.
decisions.evidence: zeros(counter=True): 1066 h, usual 21129 bikes; 254 had 350-900 per direction per day; 550 resumed at ~330/290 per day from 2021-01-21.

decisions.diagnosis: Both directions read zero through a weekday morning peak and then resumed normally, a counter outage (likely a maintenance visit); the riders in those slots cannot be recovered.
decisions.evidence: zeros(counter=True): 6.75 h, 5.5 daytime h, usual 188 bikes; day total 142/121 vs 282/222 the day before; neighbours normal.

decisions.diagnosis: Both directions reported 'good' zeros for a month while neighbours 254 and 554 counted normally; nothing was backfilled, so the counts are lost.
decisions.evidence: zeros(counter=True): 777.75 h, usual 15686 bikes; 254 had 360-700 per direction per day throughout; counts resume at 09:00 on 2022-09-08.

decisions.diagnosis: TfNSW flagged three whole days as 'warning' zeros in both directions while neighbour 254 counted 400-540 per direction per day; the counts were not recorded.
decisions.evidence: raw status 'warning' on 2023-06-30 to 2023-07-02; zeros(counter=True) 78 h, usual 1250 bikes; days either side ~250-390 per direction.

series.name: George St northbound (citybound)
series.evidence: Metrocount 362 replaced Ecocounter 226 on the same path after a 5-month gap; the northbound hourly workday profile is almost identical (Feb-Apr 2025: 41.7/73.6/31.0 at 7/8/9h vs Nov 2025-Mar 2026: 41.7/71.0/30.1), and the site's ratio to continuous neighbours is unchanged (to 106: ~1.0-1.1 before and after; to 158: ~0.8-0.9 before and after).

series.name: George St southbound
series.evidence: Same replacement; the southbound hourly profile matches closely (17h: 66.2 before vs 65.3 after, 8h: 29.2 vs 31.0), the north/south ratio is similar (1.15 vs 1.19), and the ratios to neighbours 106 and 158 are unchanged across the gap.

useful: duplicates: showed whole days where every record repeated exactly, with matched_slots equal to slots
zeros(counter=True): listed every outage with the bikes lost
daily(wide=True) across neighbours: showed that the zero stretches were local to this counter
compare: ratios to continuous neighbours 106 and 158 across the counter change
hourly: near-identical profiles confirmed the direction mapping and that the new counter reads comparably
raw: warning statuses and load dates
not_useful: spikes: only single-slot 20-30 bike blips, all plausible riding
events: nothing relevant to this site
improve: channels: the list columns are truncated in the printout; an option to explode records into columns would show duplicate pairs directly
compare: flag neighbours that themselves change counter within the range (541, 538, 561 all did here)
add: a tool comparing a site's level before and after a counter replacement against neighbours with continuous counters, same season, giving a single ratio change

summary: Site 550 (George St, Waterloo) has a long Ecocounter record (2016-2025) and a Metrocount replacement from October 2025. The Ecocounter record has about 40 days where every record was published twice (fixed by drop_duplicates) and five multi-hour to six-week outages with all-zero records while neighbours counted normally (set missing). The replacement counter's hourly profiles and ratios to continuous neighbours match the old one, so each direction is joined into one series.
